text.card: A red giant 1,324 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 2.04 solar masses and 16.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,761 K at its surface.
